recent_purchase_toast_fix.enhancement: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Filter productPool to strictly ONLY show products where `!product.hidden` (hidden !== true). If only hidden products are passed, fallback to visible defaults so hidden products never leak into live social proof toast. Also verify product exists in live catalog.

product_section_rule.rule: MUST REMAIN UNTOUCHED IN BEHAVIOR: keep search, sort, category chips, green WhatsApp Deal button, Add to Cart, star reviews, and exact data-testids intact.

multi_select_and_sticky_bulk_bar.selection: Per-row checkbox + header select-all (current page or filtered set)
multi_select_and_sticky_bulk_bar.sticky_bar: Floats at top or bottom with selected count, Clear selection, Bulk Quick Edit, Bulk Make Visible, Bulk Hide, Bulk Move to Trash

bulk_edit_modal.title: Bulk Edit Selected Products
fields: Change Stock Status (Available, Limited Stock, Out of Stock)
Set Stock Quantity (Fixed value or skip)
Adjust Price: Set fixed price string OR % adjustment on numeric price (e.g. +10%, -10%)
Set Visibility (Show on website / Hide from website)

inline_quick_edit.fields: Price, Stock quantity, Stock status dropdown, and Visibility toggle directly from table row without opening full modal
inline_quick_edit.feedback: Instant save with optimistic update + toast notification

add_product_modal_all_ways.way_1_single: Comprehensive modal with fields: product_name, category, price, stock_status, stock, description, image_url (or direct file upload), visible toggle. Includes 'Save & Add Another' button which resets form while keeping category for super fast repetitive entry.
add_product_modal_all_ways.way_2_duplicate: Row action 'Duplicate Product' that clones existing product with '(Copy)' prefix, opens modal prefilled for 1-click clone.

way_3_excel_csv_import.sample_template: Downloadable CSV template (`az_distribution_products_template.csv`) with columns: product_name, category, price, stock_status, stock, image_url, description
way_3_excel_csv_import.upload_and_preview: Parses CSV in browser, displays interactive preview table with validation (flags missing name/category/image), allows fixing before hitting 'Import X Products'. Supports CSV and XLSX.

add_product_modal_all_ways.export_csv: Export current catalog or filtered view to CSV file instantly

trash_and_recovery_flow.soft_delete: Delete button on product row moves product to Trash (is_trash=true or stock_status='In Trash' / in_trash=true).
trash_and_recovery_flow.toast_undo: Sonner toast immediately displays 'Product moved to trash' with clickable 'Undo' button that restores it instantly.

trash_tab.view: Table of deleted items showing deleted timestamp and days remaining
actions: Delete Permanently (hard delete with double-confirmation dialog)
Empty Trash (clear all deleted products with confirmation)

endpoints.purpose: Admin list separating active products vs trash products
Batch edit any combination of fields across N products
Move selected products to trash or restore from trash
Bulk insert imported products from CSV/Excel

image_urls.description: Opened premium box of imported chocolates, pristine confectionery display
Assorted brand chocolate bars and snack confectionery packs
Wooden bowl filled with premium dates and dry fruits on rustic plate
Close up of vibrant colorful candies and sweet gummies

accessibility_and_performance.motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion using CSS or useReducedMotion() hook from framer-motion
accessibility_and_performance.mobile: Strict test at 390px viewport width: no horizontal overflow, touch target size >= 44x44px
accessibility_and_performance.test_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions, bulk actions, checkboxes) MUST have unique data-testid attributes
accessibility_and_performance.contrast: All text and button labels must exceed 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast against background. No purely transparent overlays without backdrop blur or scrim.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.code_language: JavaScript (.js and .jsx) — DO NOT create .tsx files
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Never use emoji icons like 🤖🧠💡. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not write 'transition: all' which causes jitter with framer-motion transforms. Specify 'transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.preserve_critical_flows: Products grid, WhatsApp ordering direct links (waUrl), and Cart drawer MUST continue functioning seamlessly with no regression.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.recent_purchase_toast: MANDATORY: Ensure only unhidden products (hidden !== true) are displayed in the toast.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.admin_login_auth: Admin panel is protected by existing token ('az-admin-token') and backend JWT. All admin routes send Bearer Authorization header.
